senses.gloss: m. (סלי = סלל, v. סוֹל) rod, esp. prick, thorn.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:26">Targ. Job XL, 26</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 25:18">Targ. II Chr. XXV, 18</cite>.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:13">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>דחרזיה ס׳</he> who was stung by a thorn.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>חמימי לס׳</he> hot water is good for a thorn sting; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 91a:21">Keth. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>בס׳ דלא מבע דמא</he>, v. <cite ref="N00102"><he>נְבַע</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 151b">B. Bath. 151ᵇ</cite>.—Pl. <he>סִלְוַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="O00960"><he>סִלְוַו׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00656"><he>סִלְוִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00962"><he>סִלְוֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00067"><he>סִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:2">Targ. Cant. II, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 31:40">Targ. Job XXXI, 40</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:1">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> top <he>שבעה ס׳ וכ׳</he> seven prickles from seven palm-trees.—

Yoma 75ᵇ (in Hebr. dict.) (ref. to שְׂלָו) כתב שליו וקרינן סְלָיו … צדיקים אוכלין אותו בשַׁלְוָה … ודומה להן כסִילְוִין it is written with ש (and may be read sh’lav), and we read s’lav; … the righteous ate it (the quail) in safety, but the wicked ate it, and it appeared to them like thorns; Yalk. Ex. 260 כסִילְוִים; Yalk. Num. 738 אוכלין אותו בסילוא (corr. acc.); v. סְלָיו.
